description: A terrible connection: a weak mobile signal on the move or a satellite link. 400 ms round trip with 100 ms of jitter, 10 % of the packets lost in each direction, three tenths of that in bursts, a few packets arriving twice, and the line down for 3 s every minute, the first time a minute after the client's first packet.

allowances.reason: the round trip of 400 ms plus the jitter of 100 ms

notApplicable.reason: the profile loses 10 % of the packets and cuts the line for 3 s every minute, and owner snapshots travel unreliably, so some never arrive by design; snapshot_drops still judges whether the worker sent them all
the line is down for 3 s every minute, which the outage is there to test, so the rate measures the outage
